name: tar1090 Bearing & Range Tool
description: On tar1090 / ADS-B Exchange maps: click an aircraft to draw a live bearing-and-range line to your cursor, then click a second aircraft (or a fixed map point) to lock the line. True bearings (both directions) and great-circle range update continuously as aircraft move. For a fixed point, terrain elevation is looked up via the Open-Meteo Elevation API (Copernicus DEM) and used (terrain + 1.5 m) for slant-range and vertical-separation figures.
